_comment: Commands the Process tab may start (Files -> a folder -> Run). Nothing else can be started.
Copy this file to ~/.config/vyrii/process_tools.json and edit it there: when that file exists it
replaces this one entirely - another stack of tools needs no change in vyrii.
Not inside ~/.vyrii: Files -> Upload writes there, and whoever writes this file decides what Run starts.
args: {port} {host} {root} are filled in (root = the chosen folder inside ~/.vyrii; it is also the cwd).
port: the default port, or null for a tool without a web page (only its log is shown).
os: optional list of platforms (linux, win32, darwin); elsewhere the command is shown as unavailable.
reserved_ports: never offered as a free port, beside the ports of the tools below.

tools.name: mokosh
tools.label: mokosh ui — dataset: setup, ingest, status

tools.name: syryn
tools.label: syryn — Bluetooth beacon P:<ip> (no web page, log only)
